Siri, call my pawns.

text:

"[The furlough] was an incredibly difficult decision, but one that was necessary to help us eventually bring back as many people as possible."

text:

No Season-ing.

text:

"Oof, a mine!"

text:
Be warned: Nivalis Nights may not be the cozy game you expect: 'If you want a cozy existence in this city, you're going to have to earn it'
It wouldn't be the first cozy game with horrific debts to pay, though.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The advent of first-person shooters introduced a wild frontier of unregulated video game level packs, and it ended in a lawsuit that changed copyright forever
Revisiting the forgotten fourth state of PC gaming.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Expect plenty more Silent Hill over the next few years, as Konami has plans for 'second and third waves' of new games in its revived horror series
"We're currently looking at a number of projects," says producer Motoi Okamoto.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'If you're skilful enough, you can chop the head off a monster, kick it midair, and then kill another monster with it': Consider me sold on this indie first-person ARPG
Heathen puts a new perspective on Diablo, and it looks brilliant.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Mafia 3, which PC Gamer scored 54% but which I say is great, got a nice little 10th-anniversary update
As ever, I'm a genius tastemaker ahead of my time.

author: PC Gamer
text:
2026's OLED monitors can nearly recreate the sublime clarity of a '90s CRT, but Windows will have to change before we can achieve true nirvana
All you need is a ridiculously fast monitor and endless patience for tinkering to get a glimpse of how good retro games looked in motion back in the '90s.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'Overcooked broke you apart and Stage Fright is there to put you back together'
Developers of the stressful cooking game series talk to PC Gamer about their more 'positive' co-op adventure.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Cyberpunk 2077 is being made into a movie, even though we've already got the perfect cyberpunk movie starring Keanu Reeves as a guy named Johnny
Remember Johnny Mnemonic? If you haven't seen it, it's time.

text:
